SESSION	CREATE OR REPLACE TEMPORARY VIEW testData AS SELECT * FROM VALUES
READ	SELECT a FROM testData ORDER BY A
READ	SELECT a as alias FROM testData ORDER BY ALIAS
READ	SELECT a AS k FROM testData ORDER BY 'k'
READ	SELECT 1 AS k FROM testData ORDER BY 'k'
READ	SELECT concat_ws(' ', a, b) FROM testData ORDER BY `concat_ws( , a, b)`
READ	SELECT 1 AS a FROM testData ORDER BY a
READ	SELECT 1 AS a FROM testData ORDER BY `a`
READ	SELECT 1 ORDER BY `1`
READ	SELECT a, b FROM testData ORDER BY a, (SELECT b FROM testData LIMIT 1)
READ	SELECT a FROM testData ORDER BY (SELECT b FROM testData)
READ	SELECT a, b FROM testData ORDER BY a, b IN (SELECT a FROM testData)
READ	SELECT a, b FROM testData ORDER BY a, EXISTS(SELECT b FROM testData)
READ	SELECT a AS k, c FROM testData ORDER BY k
READ	SELECT 1 AS `2`, 2 FROM VALUES (2) t (`2`) ORDER BY `2`
READ	SELECT 2, 1 AS `2` FROM VALUES (2) t (`2`) ORDER BY `2`
READ	SELECT 1 AS `2` FROM VALUES (2) t (`2`) ORDER BY `2`
READ	SELECT 2 FROM VALUES (2) t (`2`) ORDER BY `2`
